description: Retrieve progress, candidate themes or the released complete Visibility Check. Read the same operation after reconnecting; polling costs nothing. While deep collection runs, progress.partial holds the selected themes, first searches and competitor benchmarks collected so far and progress.pending lists what is still running: answer with them, labelled partial, instead of waiting for the report. progress.failure says what failed and whether a new check would help; follow its nextStep instead of restarting blindly. Return evidence, scope, freshness and limitations honestly. A report awaiting review is not yet released, and a partial report is not a complete outcome. ownedAccounts lists the brand's own account per platform as resolved (with profileUrl and source), not_found (the brand website's own social links and a completed handle lookup showed none) or unresolved (not checked, or the check was inconclusive; reason says which, and source and profileUrl name any claimed account). not_found reports absence from the sources inspected, not proof that the brand has no account on that platform. evidenceLinks maps every video and profile evidenceId the report cites to its public URL; cite them.
